description: This Java source file contains an immutable implementation of the interface FilteredTopic, including a builder pattern for object creation, a parser for string representations, and associated methods for handling topic filtering logic within the Eclipse Ditto project.

classes.name: ImmutableFilteredTopic
classes.description: Immutable implementation of the FilteredTopic interface, representing a filtered topic with various attributes like topic name, namespaces, filter string, and extra fields.

classes.name: ImmutableFilteredTopic.ImmutableFilteredTopicBuilder
classes.description: A thread-unsafe builder class for constructing instances of ImmutableFilteredTopic with a fluent API.

classes.name: ImmutableFilteredTopic.FilteredTopicStringParser
classes.description: A private static class responsible for parsing a filtered topic string into an ImmutableFilteredTopic instance, handling URL decoding and query parameter extraction.

methods.name: getBuilder
methods.description: Returns a builder object for creating an ImmutableFilteredTopic instance with specified topic.

methods.name: fromString
methods.description: Creates an ImmutableFilteredTopic instance from its string representation.

methods.name: getTopic
methods.description: Returns the topic associated with this filtered topic.

methods.name: getNamespaces
methods.description: Returns the list of namespace strings.

methods.name: getExtraFields
methods.description: Returns an optional JsonFieldSelector representing extra fields.

methods.name: length
methods.description: Returns the length of the string representation.

methods.name: charAt
methods.description: Returns the character at a specified index in the string representation.

methods.name: subSequence
methods.description: Returns a subsequence of the string representation.
